summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a Form 6-K announcing weekly open-market share repurchases under a EUR 1 billion buyback programme launched 17 February 2026. From 6-10 July 2026, it bought 185,000 ordinary shares on US venues (avg. ~$106.09) and 76,913 on London venues (avg. ~£79.54) via Goldman Sachs entities; shares will be cancelled. The programme is ongoing with no stated expiration, implying a continuous capital return strategy. No board recommendation or advisors are named; the filing is purely transactional. What to watch: pace of repurchase and remaining EUR-authorised capacity.
